products.name: Legends Awakened Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs. TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: Legends Awakened Three Pack Blister [Latias / Latios]
products.note: Two Legends Awakened packs, a Secret Wonders pack (not simulated), a Rayquaza coin and a cosmos holo Latias or Latios from POP Series 7 (reprints, not simulated). Bulbapedia's merchandise page excerpt and PokeBeach's 'Holo POP 7 Latios and Latias Promos' post.

products.name: Legends Awakened Two Pack Blister [Mothim]
products.note: One Legends Awakened pack and one POP Series 6 pack (not simulated) with a cosmos holo Mothim from POP Series 7 (a reprint, not simulated). Bulbapedia's merchandise page, one source.

products.name: Dialga Premium Box
products.note: Two Diamond & Pearl-series packs (opened here as Legends Awakened packs), a Diamond & Pearl-series theme deck (not simulated), the cosmos holo Dialga promo (DP26) and a jumbo Dialga (not simulated); $19.99 at launch. PokeBeach's 2008 post, an Amazon listing and Collector's Cache.

products.name: Palkia Premium Box
products.note: Two Diamond & Pearl-series packs (opened here as Legends Awakened packs), a Diamond & Pearl-series theme deck (not simulated), the cosmos holo Palkia promo (DP27) and a jumbo Palkia (not simulated); $19.99 at launch. PokeBeach's 2008 post, an Amazon listing and Collector's Cache.
